arc: repo lockup → stat (star counter tallies up with contributor avatars streaming) → number exits on the lockup

scenes.title: Star counter to 180,598 with rising contributor-avatar bubbles
scenes.summary: Light #FAFAFA frame. The Firecrawl flame + 'firecrawl/firecrawl' lockup drops in at the top and breathes. A big orange filled star and a 250px counter blur up and tally from 0 to 180,598 over 4 seconds, with 'GitHub stars' blurring up beneath; on landing the number punches to 1.06×. Throughout, 64 round white-bordered contributor avatars float up from the bottom with a sine sway, mostly along the left and right thirds, fading before the top band. The number and label blur out in the last ~22 frames, leaving the lockup.
scenes.build: One AbsoluteFill: BUBBLES is precomputed from AVATARS (components/avatars.ts) with seeded random() for launch time (spread across the count-up), x (60% biased to the sides to keep the copy column clear), size, sway and frequency; each bubble's y eases bottom→top with a bezier and fades by y position. Counter is <CountText>, label <TextAnimation preset="blurUp">, punch/out are interpolates against useWindowDuration().
scenes.reuse: Any community milestone: stars, users, members, downloads. Swap STAR_COUNT/REPO in components/brand.ts, the mark image and the avatar list (any faces work). The side-biased rising-avatar stream is the borrowable idea. Don't reuse Firecrawl's flame or orange unless it's Firecrawl.
